Maya H: Heads-up — QBR pack draft needs partner scorecard + MDF reallocation proposal by Tues AM. Can we run a quick sprint today?
Owen T: I can join. What's the ask on MDF — full rebudget or targeted reallocations?
Priya V: Targeted. Finance prefers shifting underspent co-marketing to marketplace credits for SI enablement. They want impact forecasted (30/60/90d pipeline).
Luis G: Agree with targeted. Suggest we create two buckets: (A) enablement credits for top 8 SIs, (B) co-marketing microgrants for emerging marketplace partners.
Maya H: Good split. Owen — can you surface top 12 partners by 90d pipeline velocity and unspent MDF? Use the 'partner_fund_status' tab.
Owen T: On it. Dropping CSV to drive in 10m: https://drive.redwood/pairs/partner-funds.csv
Priya V: Quick ask on scorecard: can we bump pipeline momentum weight and add a short checklist for 'SI playbook readiness'? Need to avoid subjective scoring.
Luis G: Proposed quick rubric for playbook readiness:
```
Playbook readiness (0-3):
0 = No joint playbook
1 = Draft playbook, no enablement
2 = Playbook + 1 joint GTM event
3 = Playbook + enablement + sales motions + proof points
```
Maya H: Perfect. Also add 'marketplace integration status' as a pass/fail quick flag (API listing, billing verified).
FinanceBot: FYI: Current MDF headroom = $150,000. Reallocating 25% to credits frees $37,500. Please attach expected conversion assumptions.
Priya V: If we assume 6% conversion to closed in 90d for enablement credits (conservative), $37.5k targeting SIs yields ~ $225k ACV closed — need to show that math in pack.
Owen T: CSV uploaded and marked unspent rows. Two notes: (1) some co-marketing earmarks are contractual through Q3 — can't reassign, (2) marketplace credit budget is currently unallocated.
Maya H: OK — action list: Owen -> validate fund constraints and drop final CSV by 16:00; Priya -> add playbook readiness rubric + marketplace integration flag to scorecard; Luis -> map top-8 SI candidates and estimated credit amount; Maya -> compile 2 slides for QBR.
Luis G: I'll propose credit bands: $5k, $10k, $20k based on SI maturity. Will annotate rationale in the sheet.
Priya V: Also propose a one-month pilot: convert up to $25k into instant credits (expire 60d) and track 90d pipeline delta. If pilot beats 4x ROI, scale.
Maya H: Love it. Partnerships-bot: set reminder for 'Partner ops sprint check' at 15:30 PT today.
partnerships-bot: Reminder set: 'Partner ops sprint check' added to calendar for 2026-06-10 15:30 PT (organizer: Maya H).
Owen T: Will do a quick pre-read table for execs — two slides: (1) scorecard deltas + rubric, (2) MDF reallocation plan + pilot ROI scenario.
Maya H: Great. Please keep comments inline in the sheet. I'll circulate final deck by 08:30 Tues for review. Thanks all :rocket:
